Which frame should be rendered when rendering a still. Default `0`. From v3.2.27, negative values are allowed, with `-1` being the last frame.

## CLI flag

```text
--frame <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)
- [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#frame)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#frame)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#frame)
- [`renderStillOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-still-on-web#frame)
